title: Ruuhuuji ɗi Trench
intro: Aɗa hoota e yonta mo laamɗo mo yurmeende mum alaa, ɗaɓɓiri dewal timmungal e laamɓe fenaande. Renndo tokooso ruuhuuji dewondirɗi salii, njooɗii e jukkungo tiiɗngo haa wonti kuddi haa abada. Daartol maɓɓe ina ɓuuɓtoo e nder Qur’aana, ko seedantaagal goonɗinal ngal ɓuuɓnataa. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude ndee fedde tiiɗnde?
clues: En nguuriino e leydi les njiimaandi laamɗo ɗaɓɓoowo dewal laamɓe fenaande
Renndo men ina joginoo tooñanngeeji mawɗi tan sabu goongɗinde men e Alla tan
Laamɗo oo yamiri yo ɓuuɓol mawngol ɓuuɓne, ɓuuɓnee e ɓuuɓol mawngol
Sabu en njaɓaani woppude goonɗinal men, en mberlaa e oon ɓuuɓri ɓuuɓndi gooto gooto
Daartol amen naati e nder Quraan, tooñooɓe en ɓee ngoni ko e kuddi haa abada
Suura winnduɗo jarribo men oo inniraa ko maandeeji asamaan mawɗi asamaan ɗii

trial.label: Ñaawoore men
options: Wuleede ina wuuri e nder ɓuuɓri yiite
Siineede e nder ngaska duuɓi keewɗi
trial.answer: Wuleede ina wuuri e nder ɓuuɓri yiite

location.label: Elemen Key
options: Ladde udditiinde nde henndu bonndu ɓuuɓnata

outcome.label: Jaabawol men
options: Min martiraa, tooñooɓe ɓee huɗaa haa abada
En ngummiima caggal nde ɗaaniɗen duuɓi 309
En mbayliima wonti apes ngam tooñannge men
Henndu mawndu ɓuuɓndu halki en fof
Wooyre wootere bonnde, ɓuuɓni gonndigal men
outcome.answer: Min martiri, tooñooɓe ɓee huɗaa haa abada

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
